# The common key migration keeps printable test inputs as literal characters

This migration uses literal space, comma and period values for printable test input, while non-printable names use KEY_ descriptors. The command test keeps manifest shortcut names and modifier objects separate, then passes key and modifiers to BrowserTestUtils before checking the received command name and tab type. The details test directly checks its open state after literal space and KEY_Enter. This is scoped caller and test-source evidence; it does not establish native keyboard equivalence or a project-wide production-key rewrite.

Scope: Thunderbird browser-test keyboard migration.
